category_edits.rationale: Reverse-distance positions regressed in prior trials. Instead, preserve chronological positions for the first 16 tokens and compress later positions into pairs. This retains precise ordering for short histories while reducing positional fragmentation for longer histories, without truncating observed interactions. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so training and appended-mask inference share the position mapping and unchanged checkpoint shapes.

edits.replace:
chronological_pos = nonpadding.cumsum(dim=1)
        pos = torch.where(
            chronological_pos <= 16,
            chronological_pos,
            16 + (chronological_pos - 16 + 1) // 2,
        ) * nonpadding

change_summary: Across all four category models, retain chronological positions through 16 and use paired position buckets thereafter. Preserve histories, final-mask readout, embeddings, backbone, scoring, loss, optimizer, and predictor compatibility.
